ai_summary: AAVAS Financiers Limited has issued a regulatory disclosure announcing its 16th Annual General Meeting (AGM) for FY 2025-26, to be held virtually on September 16, 2026. The company is actively ensuring compliance with SEBI regulations by disseminating the Annual Report and AGM notice, providing web-links to all shareholders, including those without registered email addresses, along with key e-voting dates. This standard compliance filing ensures broad shareholder access to critical information and governance processes, presenting no immediate red flags.
